about: Six standalone pages with KNOWN design quality, rendered at 1280x800. `node shoot.mjs fixtures` runs the D1 lint on each and compares with this file; the same expectations are the unit-test fixtures for the Rust port (PLAN-THE-DESIGN S1: 'lints separate a fixture pair of known-good/known-bad pages; no false positive on a plain shop page'). A check listed in must_pass or must_fail is asserted; a check listed in neither is not asserted for that page (it is allowed to go either way).

thresholds.text_contrast: ratio >= 4.5 (>= 3.0 for text >= 24px, or >= 18.66px at weight >= 700); ok when zero text nodes are below
thresholds.spacing_scale: share of non-zero margin/padding/gap values that are multiples of 4px (+-0.5) >= 0.9 AND distinct values <= 10; horizontal margins > 64px are skipped as auto-centering
thresholds.type_scale: distinct font sizes (text-bearing elements) <= 6 AND distinct weights <= 4 AND every consecutive pair of sizes differs by a ratio >= 1.125
thresholds.palette_size: distinct colours (text, background, drawn borders) after quantising each channel to 16 steps <= 12
thresholds.alignment: in a stacked container (>= 3 children, each on its own row) the left edges, or the centres, form one cluster; in a single-row container the tops, or the vertical centres, or the bottoms form one cluster (tolerance 1.5px); grids and wrapped rows are not judged
thresholds.overflow_clipping: no element with overflow hidden/clip whose content is larger than its box and that holds text (single-line text-overflow:ellipsis is intentional and skipped); no horizontal page scroll; nothing past the right edge outside a scroller
thresholds.tap_targets: every visible link/button/input/select/summary is >= 32x32 px (inline links inside running text and checkbox/radio inputs with a bigger label are exempt)
thresholds.states: among probed buttons/links >= 80% change computed style on :hover, and among elements reached with Tab >= 80% change on :focus
thresholds.defaults: no button/select/input/textarea still carries the user-agent look (13.33px UA font with the grey bevel/#767676 border/#efefef fill)

good-shop.html.what: nav, headline, three product cards with a primary button; 8px scale (8/16/24/32/48), 14/16/32px type, 400/600 weights, one accent, 40px targets, hover + focus-visible

good-form.html.what: checkout form with labels above inputs on one left edge, a three-column row, a styled select, a summary panel; 14/16/24px type

good-list.html.what: orders list: toolbar with input + select + button on one 40px centre line, rows on one grid, status pills with AA contrast; 14/16/24px type

bad-spacing-type-colour.html.what: nine font sizes (11 12 13 14 15 16 17 19 22) and six weights, margins/paddings on no grid (3 5 6 7 9 11 13 17 19 21 23 27 29), 23 unrelated colours; everything else deliberately fine

bad-contrast-defaults.html.what: #a3a3a3 body copy and heading on white (2.52:1), bare browser-default input/select/button/submit, two 20x20 icon buttons; one clean left-aligned column

bad-misaligned-clipped.html.what: columns starting at 0/14/6px with different heights, a stacked list with left edges 0/7/13/3, two boxes that clip their text, 20px targets, outline:none and no hover on every control; dark text on white, few colours, flat styled controls
